shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && git diff package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -50 && cat node_modules/next/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep '"version"'
ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "proxy.ts" node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; cat app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json

npx next build 2>&1 | tail -15 && (npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 4 && curl -sI http://localhost:3123/ | grep -i x-request-id && curl -sI http://localhost:3123/foo | grep -i x-request-id; sleep 1; cat /tmp/next.log; pkill -f "next start" || true
git diff tsconfig.json; git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts && git status --short
